gaps.sentence: We're going to ___ our flight if we don't hurry.
gaps.hint: be too late for a plane
gaps.explanation: 'miss a flight/train/bus' = arrive too late for it.

gaps.sentence: The thief is believed ___ entered through the roof.
gaps.explanation: 'is believed to have + participle' for a past event.

gaps.sentence: The findings will be published in ___ course.
gaps.hint: in ___ course = at the right time
gaps.explanation: 'In due course' = eventually, when the time is right.

gaps.sentence: The report needs ___ before Friday, doesn't it?
She's very good ___ explaining difficult ideas.
There were ___ many customers for the staff to serve properly.
gaps.explanation: 'Too many … to …' — excess preventing an outcome.

gaps.sentence: The bridge is ___ repair, so traffic uses the bypass.
He's got a ___ of stamps from every country he's visited.
gaps.explanation: Noun form: collection (a group of collected items).
